findings.reason: The row now freezes caller-supplied byte, depth and node limits, inclusive boundary checks and typed refusal before a future implementation can claim a bounded decoder from JSON's parser alone.
The contract rejects duplicate object keys at any depth, NaN/Infinity, extra trailing values and invalid UTF-8, while preserving ordinary finite values and avoiding a second canonical serializer.

The execution write scope is limited to the new module, focused test, two contract pages and its review record. It excludes readers, CLI, provider, changelog, shared queue updates during development and publication.

An ephemeral fresh-context Codex reviewer was started against the exact two-path diff, but the configured model route emitted continuous telemetry warnings and produced no verdict after seven minutes. The process was stopped; no review pass is inferred from it.
